title: 🛡️ Strategic Indigenous Defence — Dhruv-NG Shakti Engine, ICGS Samudra Pratap & Scramjet (>Mach 5)
summary: HAL completed maiden flight of 5.5-tonne Dhruv New Generation (NG) twin-engine helicopter in Bengaluru and received DGCA certification for Shakti Civil Engine.

blocks.content: **Overview**: HAL completed maiden flight of 5.5-tonne Dhruv New Generation (NG) twin-engine helicopter in Bengaluru and received DGCA certification for Shakti Civil Engine.

items: **HAL Conducts Maiden Flight of Dhruv-NG Helicopter with Indigenous Shakti Civil Engine** (Page 110): HAL completed maiden flight of 5.5-tonne Dhruv New Generation (NG) twin-engine helicopter in Bengaluru and received DGCA certification for Shakti Civil Engine.

**Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Commissions ICGS Samudra Pratap Pollution Control Vessel** (Page 110): Goa Shipyard Limited built ICGS Samudra Pratap, 1st of two indigenously designed Pollution Control Vessels (60%+ indigenous content), commissioned at Goa.

**DRDO Successfully Tests Long-Duration Actively Cooled Scramjet Engine (>Mach 5) at DRDL** (Page 112): DRDO conducted ground test of full-scale actively cooled scramjet engine at DRDL SCPT facility in Hyderabad for hypersonic cruise missiles (>Mach 5).

**DRDO Flight-Tests 3rd Gen MPATGM with Top Attack Capability Against Moving Target** (Page 112): DRDO successfully tested 3rd generation Fire & Forget Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile (MPATGM) with IIR homing seeker and tandem warhead at KK Ranges, Ahilya Nagar.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Defence Indigenisation & Strategic Propulsion. Major defence milestones: Dhruv-NG helicopter maiden flight with Shakti engine, ICGS Samudra Pratap PCV, DRDO Scramjet ground test, and 3rd Gen MPATGM.
